sources.title: OpenCode Config — Compaction
sources.keyClaim: Compaction can be configured via `compaction` option: auto (bool), prune (bool), reserved (token buffer).

sources.title: Shedding Heavy Memories: Context Compaction in Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode
sources.keyClaim: OpenCode uses 2-step compaction: prune (timestamp-based hide, keep 40k tokens + last 2 user turns) then LLM 5-heading summary. After summarization, last user message is auto-replayed.

sources.title: Issue #27315 — Auto-compaction in empty sessions
sources.keyClaim: Bug: auto-compaction triggering too early in v1.14.48. Closed as duplicate of #8625.

sources.title: Issue #11314 — Configurable Context Compaction Threshold
sources.keyClaim: OpenCode triggers compaction at hardcoded 75% of model's context window. Feature request for configurable threshold.

sources.title: Issue #4659 — Sliding window context management
sources.keyClaim: Proposed inception messages (preserve: true) that survive all compactions. Chess-clock auto-pruning based on active conversation time.

sources.title: Issue #16512 — Improve compaction prompt to preserve critical context
sources.keyClaim: Compaction LLM should keep exact names, file paths, identifiers. Feature request for preservation improvements.

sources.title: Reddit: Compaction destroys opencode for me, any tips?
sources.keyClaim: Keep every section, preserve exact file paths and identifiers, prefer terse bullets over paragraphs.

sources.title: OpenCode Docs — Instructions/Rules
sources.keyClaim: Instruction files via `instructions` option are loaded as system prompt and survive compaction.
